title: Girl A
author: Abigail Dean
notes: After escaping an abusive childhood, Lex Gracie must confront her past when she and her siblings inherit their family home.

title: One Last Secret
author: Adele Parks
notes: Hoping to leave her secretive job behind, Dora accepts one final assignment that draws her into a dangerous world of lies and hidden motives.

title: The Push
author: Ashley Audrain
notes: A mother fears that something is wrong with her daughter, but as her family doubts her, she begins to question her own instincts.

title: In My Dreams I Hold a Knife
author: Ashley Winstead
notes: At a college reunion, six friends are forced to confront the unsolved murder of a classmate and the secrets they have kept since.

title: Demon Copperhead
author: Barbara Kingsolver
notes: Born into poverty in Appalachia, a boy navigates foster care, addiction and loss in this modern retelling of David Copperfield.

title: The Long Way to a Small, Angry Planet
author: Becky Chambers
notes: A young woman joins the eclectic crew of a tunnelling spaceship, finding friendship and belonging as they journey across the galaxy.

title: The Long Shoe
author: Bob Mortimer
notes: When his girlfriend disappears and his job and home are under threat, a man finds his luck changing in this surreal comic mystery.

title: Lessons in Chemistry
author: Bonnie Garmus
notes: A brilliant chemist challenges 1960s gender norms.

title: Strangers in the car
author: C M Ewan
notes: Strangers in the Car follows Abi and Ben, who—while driving home late at night on foggy country roads—reluctantly stop to help a stranded family with a baby. But once the strangers are inside their car, the situation spirals into a tense, escalating nightmare where nothing is what it seems.

title: Yesteryear
author: Caro Claire Burke
notes: A traditional-lifestyle influencer wakes in a disturbing version of her picture-perfect life, where her family seems familiar but something is terribly wrong.

title: The nowhere child
author: Christian White

title: The New Neighbours
author: Claire Douglas
notes: A couple moves into a new home with secrets buried next door.

title: The woman who lied
author: Claire Douglas

title: Slow Gods
author: Claire North
notes: A galaxy-spanning science-fiction novel that follows Mawukana na‑Vdnaze, a man who dies, is reborn as something no longer fully human, and becomes entangled in the fate of entire civilisations after a mysterious entity called the Slow warns of a catastrophic supernova.

title: Verity
author: Colleen Hoover
notes: Dark, twisty page-turner with romantic tension and disturbing secrets.

title: The Road
author: Cormac McCarthy

title: The Tartar Steppe

title: I Capture The Castle

author: Emily St John Mandel

Blending mystery, literary fiction, and psychological drama, the novel examines how people are haunted by their choices, their losses, and the alternate versions of their lives that never came to be

title: Fried Green Tomatoes at the Whistle Stop Cafe

author: Frieda McFadden

author: Frieda McFadden

title: Do No Harm
author: Jack Jordan

title: Medea
author: Rosie Hewlett

title: Carmilla

notes: 1872 Gothic novella by Irish author, predating Dracula by 25 years, story of a young woman pursued by the vampire Carmilla

title: The Shining
author: Stephen King
notes: the mental decay of a father in a haunted hotel

title: Grain of Sand
author: Steve N Marshall
notes: Cosmic mystery meets existential themes; thought-provoking and reflective.

title: Educated
